capabilities.summary: Evaluated composition model for Right Suite video: layered video, stills, cursor sprites with hotspots, procedural backgrounds, rounded clipping, shadows, motion blur, canvas-space overlays and an independently timed webcam, with keyframed transforms, crops and opacity; pure per-frame evaluation shared by preview and export
policyNotes: Declaration-only: the composition contract and evaluation are not an ownership fingerprint.
No renderer, codec or I/O lives in this crate; CutRight and the typed FFmpeg export consume its FrameDescription.
